item.title: Bandai Namco reaffirms commitment to future Tekken 8 support following sudden departure of Katsuhiro Harada
item.description: <p>Tekken is about to enter a new era soon without the leadership and oversight from the man who's been heading up the charge for basically 30 years.</p> <p>With the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/08/katsuhiro-harada-departure-bandai-namco/">sudden departure of Executive Director Katsuhiro Harada</a>, there would of course be questions raised about the future of Tekken 8 moving forward.</p>

item.title: Warner Bros. Games didn't 'attribute any value' to Netflix in big acquisition deal, which doesn't sound great for Mortal Kombat

item.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' absence from Evo 2026 provides important clue to the game's release date
item.description: <p>Despite <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/jun/04/marvel-tokon-fighting-arcsys/">Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls being first announced</a> six months ago, it still feels like there's a lot players don't know about the project.</p> <p>PlayStation and Arc System Works have yet to reveal a release date for Marvel Tokon, but we may have a much better clue for when to expect it now.</p>

item.title: Street Fighter 6 announces new Battle HUD feature that allows players to change to those of past Street Fighter titles
item.description: <p>It appears that <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> is going to have a sizable update arriving this month, and we now know more of what it's going to include.</p> <p>Capcom just announced a new Battle HUD feature coming to Street Fighter 6 that should grab the attention of longtime fans of the series.</p>

item.title: Soul Calibur 3 release date revealed for PlayStation 5 and 4, Mortal Kombat 1 added to Xbox Game Pass
item.description: <p>PlayStation has been slowly adding classic fighting games to their digital catalog, and another one is about to arrive soon.</p> <p>Sony has revealed the release date for Soul Calibur 3 with a second big fighter hitting their service soon.</p>
